remove_small — 2D region op

• Data kinds: region → region

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "remove_small", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: select_shape (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

Usage

Removes small connected regions based on area. Equivalent to HALCON's `select_shape` (Choose regions with the aid of shape features.).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

`a が除去のしきい値（画素数）を、画像全体の画素数に対する割合 0.01〜0.16（(0.01+0.15a) * 画素数）として振る。b は未使用。しきい値以上の面積を持つ連結成分だけを残す。連結性は scipy label` の既定（4連結）。
